sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's tech sector remains a laggard due to thin liquidity and absence of large-cap pure-play software names, forcing investors to access growth via US ADRs or regional proxies.
Enterprise AI adoption is accelerating in the US, driving durable revenue visibility for platform vendors like PLTR, NOW, and ORCL, which is not yet mirrored in Indonesian corporate tech spending.
Cryptocurrency-linked equities (MSTR) and speculative movers (RUNS, YELO, SPCX) introduce outsized volatility, signaling froth that demands risk filters rather than thematic allocation.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US-listed AI/software names (PLTR, NOW, ORCL, CRWD) on enterprise AI budget momentum, but keep Indonesia tech exposure minimal—local names lack earnings catalysts. MSTR's surge is speculative leverage, not fundamental; avoid chasing. Rotate into US megacap software on pullbacks, as ID tech lags with no structural earnings driver this quarter.

sectors.name: Financials
themes: Digital banking adoption in Indonesia accelerates as fintech lenders (IMJS, NICK) scale unsecured consumer credit, outpacing traditional bank loan growth and lifting fee-based income structurally.
US crypto/brokerage momentum (COIN, HOOD) spills into Indonesian financial sentiment, but local catalysts—BI rate cuts and NIM expansion—drive durable outperformance for mid-cap banks like BTPN.
Regulatory tailwinds from OJK on digital financial inclusion and foreign ownership liberalization are unlocking M&A and capital inflows into Indonesian financials, supporting premium valuations.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian financials now: US crypto/brokerage strength (HOOD/COIN) plus domestic rate-cut expectations are re-rating ID banks (BTPN/INPC). Rotate into high-beta lenders with digital exposure (BTPN, IMJS) and hold through Q3 earnings; trim pure-play US fintechs for ID names as rupiah stabilizes.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's renewable buildout is accelerating on RUPTL revisions and local-content mandates, favoring domestic EPC contractors over equipment importers.
US grid modernization and data-center load growth are durable demand drivers for regulated utilities, irrespective of federal subsidy swings.
Inverter and module makers face margin compression from tariff volatility and Chinese oversupply, making downstream installers and utilities the safer structural bet.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in Indonesian solar EPC names (051910, MPOW) and US utility-led grid capex plays (PCG, EIX) on policy tailwinds and electrification demand; trim pure-play US equipment (FSLR, ENPH) into strength as tariff noise caps upside.

sectors.name: Infrastructure
themes: Cement demand is structurally supported by IKN Phase-2 tenders and 2024-25 national road rehabilitation budgets, insulating SMGR/SMKM from aggregate volatility.
Private toll-road operators (AXON) benefit from durable urban sprawl and logistics corridor shifts, with traffic elasticity rising as fuel subsidies are rationalized.
Port and logistics infrastructure (PACK, MIRA) faces a structural headwind from commodity export volume normalization, despite short-term tariff-driven bounces.
sectors.ai: Rotate into cement and construction names (SMGR, SMKM) on IDR stabilization and Jokowi's final-year project disbursement; HOPE's +22% is a liquidity spike, not a trend. Trim exporters (PACK, MIRA) as US rate-cut bets fade. Accumulate AXON selectively on toll-road traffic data. Watch KUAS for follow-through, but avoid chasing post-pop.

US exposure remains a drag, so overweight local-currency pure plays. Accumulate on dips toward support; trim names with US revenue links.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's crypto adoption is driven by regulatory clarity (Bappebti/CoFTRA licensing) and a young, mobile-first population using local exchanges—structural tailwind for liquid majors over speculativ
Global macro liquidity easing and the US election cycle are re-rating risk assets; altcoins with staking/DeFi utility (ADA, UNI, ARB) capture durable institutional flows versus meme-driven spikes.
Token unlock schedules (WLD, CAKE) and low-float supply create persistent sell-pressure asymmetry—favor assets with high circulating supply and proven revenue models for sustained upside.
sectors.ai: Buy selective large-cap liquid alts (ADA, UNI, ARB) into this broad risk-on squeeze; LIT/ZEC/ENA are low-liquidity spikes—trim into strength. Indonesia's retail flow is chasing via local OTC and P2P, so expect faster mean-reversion on small caps. Add ADA/UNI on any 5-7% pullback within 48h; avoid chasing WLD/CAKE given token unlock overhang.
